Average the $x$-intercepts:
$$x=\frac{-6+2}{2}=-2.$$

answer.worked: $$\begin{aligned}y&=2x^2+5x+2x+5\\y&=x(2x+5)+(2x+5)\\y&=(2x+5)(x+1)\end{aligned}$$
$a=2>0$, so the parabola is concave up.

Let $x=0$.
$$\begin{aligned}y&=2(0)^2+7(0)+5\\y&=5\end{aligned}$$
The $y$-intercept is $(0,5)$.

Let $y=0$.
$$0=(2x+5)(x+1).$$
By the null factor law, $2x+5=0$ or $x+1=0$, so $x=-\frac52$ or $x=-1$.
The $x$-intercepts are $\left(-\frac52,0\right)$ and $(-1,0)$.

Mean of the $x$-intercepts:
$$x=\frac{-\frac52+(-1)}{2}=-\frac74.$$
Substitute $x=-\frac74$:
$$\begin{aligned}y&=2\left(-\frac74\right)^2+7\left(-\frac74\right)+5\\y&=\frac{49}{8}-\frac{98}{8}+\frac{40}{8}\\y&=-\frac98\end{aligned}$$
The vertex is $\left(-\frac74,-\frac98\right)$.
